description: A Minecraft Mod Using Fabric Modding Toolchain

releases.notes:
This update features multiplayer compatibility and teleportation fix. Previously, teleportation is done by sending teleportation request packet to the server, and then I realised this is not possible in multiplayer? And why add the hassle when `Entity.teleport` is already available? It is because sometimes when you walk on the Teleportation Plate, the server does not teleport you, but strangely when I removed this and used vanilla teleport method, it worked. I could not recreate the same bug.

If you have encountered the similar or another kind of bug, be sure to leave a ticket at the issues tab.

This update features two new enchantments for Teleporter Wand: Ascend and Descend. Both can be obtained through the Enchanting Table. When applied on Teleporter Wand, status effect is not applied to the player when used. Ascend enchantment puts user up one level, and Descend enchantment does the opposite. 

In addition, using Arrow of Teleportation (AoT) on Bow with Punch enchantment increases the target teleportation range by 5 for each level of Punch.

Fixes:
- Adding missing addition of lower limit in random teleportation equation 
- Teleportation now sends teleportation request to server instead of executing teleport command in the hope that this reduces teleportation error

Known bug:
- The new enchantments can be applied to any item. I have not been able to look for solutions. Now waiting for other devs responses.

Addition:
- Entity that is hit by Arrow of Teleportation (AoT) emits gray particles
- Player emits gray particles on using Teleporter Plate

Patches:
- Any mob that is hit by AoT is able to be teleported
- Teleportation now does not use /spreadPlayers and does not disable /gamerule sendCommandFeedback
- Breaking Teleporter Plate now drops itself

Update:
- Teleporter Wand texture
- Range of teleportation is changed for Teleporter Plate and AoT

New feature! When a Skeleton is on an End Block or any of their derivatives for 20 game ticks, the Skeleton will be equipped with and drop Arrow of Teleportation! Likewise, if they are outside of these blocks, they will turn back to a normal Skeleton.

Improve your bow combat game with Arrow of Teleportation!

Arrow of Teleportation (AoT) teleports target upon the contact of the arrow. With a normal bow, the radius of teleportation is 2 to 5 blocks. _The lower and upper limit of the range increase by 5 for each Punch enchant level. This arrow cannot be crafted and must be obtained from a skeleton drop that is killed on an End Block or any derivatives of the End Block._ (Italics: not yet implemented)

Patches:
- Command output of the player when teleporting items are used is always set to false. May require to set output back to true if necessary.

Planned Implementation:
- Make skeleton drop AoT when killed on End Block: v0.3.1
- Add particles to teleporter items: v0.3.2
- Change teleportation range of Teleporter Plate and AoT: v0.3.2
- Change item graphics: v0.3.2
- Increase AoT teleportation range based on Punch enchantment on bow: v0.4
- Add Teleporter Wand enchantment on the enchanting table (Unbreaking): v0.4
- Add mechanism to teleport downwards (possibly by making new enchantment?): v0.4
- Rigorous testing and patching: v0.5
- Future feature additions: >= v0.6, < v1
- Final release: v1
